overall_notes: The paper proposes a novel NLG evaluation method using token-level quality estimation and lexically constrained decoding. It evaluates on three NLG tasks using standard automatic metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and metric variants. The paper does not use LLM-as-judge or human evaluation methods.
